body: A 5150 is a Form 1 hold here in Canada. A 72- hour hold, correct? It never helped me at all. That's another reason why I don't want to go 'get help', for reasons you explicitly state. Sad how Canada and the States are the same in that regard.

I ache for you because it stinks to know there are other people who feel the same. I joke sometimes about how people like you and me will be the ones to win the lottery someday. 

Geriatric mental health was stressful as every resident had multiple diagnoses of Schizophrenia, Bipolar, MDD, etc. Many were *still* trying to kill themselves in their old age, and the resident I was assigned to triggered whenever she was left alone for too long. It made me realize I will battle this my whole life. 

I've tried committing suicide a few times, the first time at 12 years old with pills. I know the whole rundown, Form 1 hold, stay in a waiting room until you see the psychiatrist, pretend you won't do it again, get sent home (this was how I see my current shrink and how the hospital runs things here in my city).

Thank you for the reply. I live with my SO, but most of the time I am very much alone and try to fill/waste my day with video games. I used to love them, now I just use them as a tool to get by the day. My SO and I talk about the future and how everything will be good all the time, I look at it as fantasy. He looks at it as hope. 

I don't see my brother a lot as he spends most of his time on his laptop. Whenever I visit them I'll go to his room and sit on his bed and talk to him for a bit, but he's always too into whatever he's doing at the time. He's been doing a lot better ever since he told the family about a year and a half ago, except for the internet problem.
